subject: Expansion request: onboarding 5 additional apps + API keys / rollout plan
messages:
From: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@horizonhealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@horizonhealth.com>, DevOps Team <devops@horizonhealth.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Expansion: onboarding 5 additional apps + keys

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the help on the renewal. Quick note from our side — we want to expand Redwood to five additional internal applications across two business units (Telehealth & Patient Insights). Current usage is under the existing renewal, but these apps will significantly increase concurrent sessions during peak.

High-level asks:
- Pricing for five additional app projects (estimate for 12-month commitment)
- Lead time for provisioning additional API keys and scoped keys per app
- Recommended rollout sequence to avoid impacting production (staging -> canary -> full)
- Any changes needed to our current terms for dedicated capacity (we may need guaranteed throughput)

Procurement is looped on this thread; they will require an updated SOW/quote. Can you share a draft and an estimated go-live timeframe? We are aiming to start integrations the week of June 14.

Thanks,
Aisha Malik
Director, Platform Engineering
Horizon Health

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Aisha Malik <aisha.malik@horizonhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-18T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion: onboarding 5 additional apps + keys

Hi Aisha — great to hear, excited to support Telehealth and Patient Insights.

Quick answers up-front:
- I'll attach a draft SOW and a pricing breakdown for a 12-month committed expansion (see attachments).
- API keys: we can provision app-scoped keys. Typical lead time is 2 business days for standard keys; 5 business days if you want region-specific / restricted-network keys or HSM-backed credentials.
- Rollout: agree with staging -> canary -> full. We'll propose a phased schedule to limit concurrency spikes.
- Terms: for guaranteed throughput we'll route you to a Dedicated pool option (reserved capacity). That requires an addendum to the current agreement — we can include this in the SOW.

Action items from Redwood:
1) Draft SOW + pricing (attached) — Marissa will own technical delivery details.
2) Request list of apps + expected peak RPS and critical windows — can you share by EOD Wednesday (May 20)?
3) Confirm desired key types (standard vs. restricted/region-specific) — DevOps to confirm.

Proposed next step: 30-min sync Friday (May 21) to align tech + procurement. Does 10am PT work?

—Neha

Thanks Neha — attaching the app list below and our preferred timeline.

App list (initial):
- TeleVisit (Telehealth) — integration team: @devops, expected peak 120 RPS during clinic hours
- PostCare Insights (Patient Insights) — backend batch inference, peak 40 RPS evening run
- IntakeForms (Telehealth) — low RPS but sensitive PII; will require restricted keys
- CareNavigator (Patient Insights) — medium RPS, early access users only for first month
- AlertsEngine (Operational) — high priority, needs guaranteed throughput SLAs

Preferred go-live windows:
- Staging integrations: week of June 14
- Canary: week of June 21 (small % of traffic)
- Full rollouts: July 5+

Procurement note: we are looking at a 12-month committed capacity addendum. Please include language on guaranteed throughput and an exit clause. I’ve cc’d Mark in Procurement for contract redlines.

Aisha

Hi team — jumping in with a delivery-focused rollout plan and technical checklist.

Recommended phased rollout (detailed):
1) Staging (1 week per app): provide test keys scoped to staging environment. Run integration tests and KV/cache warmup.
2) Canary (2 weeks per app): 5–10% traffic, monitor latency P95 and token cost. If regressions appear, automatic fallback to existing model variant.
3) Gradual ramp (2–3 weeks): expand to 50% then 100% as metrics stabilize.

Technical checklist (owners):
- App-scoped API keys: Redwood (Marissa) to provision; DevOps to confirm network restrictions and key rotation window.
- Throughput sizing: Rishi to map expected RPS to Dedicated pool configuration and suggest burst capacity.
- Metric set: latency P50/P95, token cost, model quality regressions; Stephanie will hook up dashboards and alerts.
- Data handling: IntakeForms flagged for PII — recommend Private deployment or VPC ingress for those requests.

I’ve attached a redlined SOW (Horizon_Expansion_SOW_v2.pdf) and a pricing spreadsheet. High-level estimate: $XXk/month incremental for the Dedicated pool sized for peak RPS across all apps (see pricing-breakdown-may2026.xlsx).

Can we confirm the Procurement contact for issuing a PO and whether they need a separate billing entity? If Procurement can share PO templates or carrier/payment details ahead of the call, it will smooth the DocuSign step.

Thanks — happy to present this on Friday’s sync.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
